audit.whatIsWrong: The entire content layer is written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol: 'Starsurge', 'stars', 'star count', 'Comet of Legend', 'dash charges' and 'global ultimate' appear across whys[3], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[0], spikes[1], spikes[3], early, mid, late, wants.you[0] and wants.you[2]. None of those exist.
audit.why: The current kit is Breath of Light (Q, 750, channelled beam), Astral Flight (W, 1500, flies over terrain), the black hole (E, 750, percent-health execute), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R, 1250 — not global) and Stardust as the permanent stacking passive.
audit.corrected: Every spike restated in current-kit terms: stardust total instead of star count, the beam instead of Starsurge, Astral Flight instead of Comet of Legend, and The Skies Descend instead of a 'global ultimate'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is never stated: Pick a Card's gold card is Twisted Fate's only hard CC and it cancels Breath of Light mid-channel, and it is 6 seconds flat at every rank. The text also assigns the blue card to Q — whys[0], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] all say 'blue-card poke' or 'blue card (Q reset)'. Blue card is Pick a Card (W); the poke is Wild Cards (Q).
audit.why: Riot: Pick a Card 'chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack' — 6s cooldown, 200 cast range, hard CC on gold, and an attack reset. Wild Cards throws three cards on a 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s cooldown down a 10000-unit line. Aurelion Sol's Q is flagged 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', so the gold card ends the beam.
audit.corrected: Written into enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns (with 6s / 10000 / 170s), tradeBad, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t, whys[0], spikes[0].text and early. The card names are now on the correct slots.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R text, cds and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagree between layers: phases[4].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side all read 'Skill' while win[4] is 'Twisted Fate' and win[5]/win[6] are 'Aurelion Sol'. phases[4].why also argued for Aurelion Sol against a row the content layer gives to Twisted Fate.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Twisted Fate x5, then Aurelion Sol x2). Level 6 belongs to Twisted Fate on cooldowns alone: Destiny reveals the map and enables a 1.5-second Gate, while Falling Star is one 120-second stun.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side to 'Twisted Fate', phases[5].side and phases[6].side to 'Aurelion Sol'. phases[4].why rewritten so the sentence argues for the row it sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet reports sequencingCues: 0 and 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it, and dosFull[2].d invented a 'fifteen-second invitation' for an ability that is on 6 seconds.
audit.why: Defect catalogue items 3 and 6 — a magnitude with no source, and off by more than double.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with Pick a Card 6s flat, Wild Cards 6s at rank 1 over a 10000-unit line, Destiny 170s at rank 1. dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and report[5].t now carry the real six-second window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string under 'Hold R as the anti-dive stun post-6' and dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string under 'Trade HP for stacks below half health'. dontsFull[0].d also refers to a single male enemy as 'they'.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles and grounded in this kit.

notes:
THIS MATCHUP HAD THE WORST STALE-KIT DAMAGE OF MY SEVEN. The content layer was written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol throughout — Starsurge, stars, star count, Comet of Legend and 'dash charges' — and it also mislabelled Twisted Fate's cards, putting the blue card on Q. Both are fixed above. Worth checking whether the same pre-rework text seeded other aurelionsol content entries outside my slice; three of my seven briefs (twistedfate, talon, taliyah, syndra) carried 'Voice of Light' or 'Starsurge' language.

KIT FLAG MISFIRE: ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries terrain='creates terrain'. Riot says he FLIES OVER terrain and creates none. Systematic across every aurelionsol brief I read.

THREE-ROW CHART DISAGREEMENT FIXED: phases[4/5/6].side all read 'Skill' against win[4]='Twisted Fate' and win[5]/win[6]='Aurelion Sol'. packet.levelChart matches the content layer, so the full layer moved to it, and phases[4].why was rewritten to argue for Twisted Fate rather than against its own row.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Pick a Card's gold stun interrupts Astral Flight mid-flight or only prevents the cast — dontsFull[1].d says it 'ends Astral Flight the moment you arrive', which is the safe reading (the stun lands on his attack when you are in range). The ownerKit flags W as an interruptible channel and the missing-interactions rule asserts the cancel, but Riot's text does not settle mid-flight behaviour. Also unverified: whether Destiny's reveal shows Aurelion Sol while he is flying.

Templated but left standing for lack of Twisted Fate-specific grounding: breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.late, breakdown.difficulty, whys[1], whys[2], spikes[2].text and wants.foe[1] (the 'kite with W' phrasing is loose but not wrong — Astral Flight is the escape).

NOT AN ERROR, left alone: spikes[2].text's 'gold card stun into AA reset' is correct — Pick a Card carries an auto-attack reset.
